fields.title: Eswatini company search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Each successful record is one row from the official register's Company Name Search results table -- registered name, status, and registration date, exactly as the register itself displays them (no normalization).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (company name) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-aspnet-gridview (a real result row) or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), query_too_short (fewer than 3 characters), blocked_or_transient (network or session issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Registered (or reserved) entity name exactly as shown on the register.

companyStatus.title: Company status
companyStatus.description: Current register status as displayed, e.g. "COMPANY REGISTERED" or "RESERVED" (a reserved name that has not yet completed incorporation).

dateRegistered.title: Date registered
dateRegistered.description: Registration (or name-reservation) date on file, as displayed by the register (MM/DD/YYYY, not normalized).
